secrets.source: Coolify private runtime variables; separate V2 values required

release_checks: Verify exact source commit and immutable GHCR digest
Inspect actual Coolify generated Compose before startup
Reject generated proxy routes, published ports, privileged mounts or foreign networks
Verify actual Docker networks and cgroup limits immediately after startup
Require proxy absence from V2 data and RPC networks
Verify API, worker, migrations, database, authentication, replay protection and bounded read-only RPC
Verify V1 canary and neighboring service health before and after
rollback: Stop only V2 API and worker on exposure or neighbor health failure; preserve both V1 and V2 database volumes; do not restart shared proxy.
financial_cost: No additional paid service is planned; actual VPS capacity and backup cost require host verification before approval.
authorization: A separate exact manifest approval is required after Coolify-generated configuration, host capacity, secrets and backup destination are verified.
